Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production sprite animation atlas for a 2D sidescroller.
Use the attached existing R4 sprite sheet as the exact identity, drawing style, size, and GRID reference. Create a NEW sibling transparent atlas, replacing all poses with two new animations; do not keep the old idle or run sequence.
Preserve the exact 1254x1254 square canvas, four equally spaced columns and four rows, 16 full-body figures, one per cell, transparent RGBA backdrop. Preserve his youthful black rough ear-length hair, gray-green hooded short cape, indigo medieval tunic, light linen cuffs, brown belt/pouch, dark trousers and worn boots, face/body proportions, hand-drawn pixel-like rendering and line weight.
Rows 1 and 2 read left-to-right as ONE 8-frame RUN-START animation all facing RIGHT: first relaxed right-facing stand; then slight knee bend and weight lowering; forward lean, arms prepare; rear heel rises; push-off; front foot advances; first running stride; last right-facing running contact pose matching reference run. Subtle anticipation, no huge leaps.
Rows 3 and 4 read left-to-right as ONE 8-frame TURN animation, from facing RIGHT to facing LEFT via the FRONT: right profile bracing; right three-quarter torso; three-quarter front; full front facing viewer with BOTH shoulders/eyes; front with head looking left; left three-quarter; left profile stepping out; last LEFT-facing run pose. Crucial: bottom row ends unmistakably facing LEFT. Do not repeat right-facing run poses for the turn. Feet pivot under body, body rotates, pouch changes side with body rotation. Character stays centered, same size, feet aligned to each cell baseline, head ~25 pixels from cell top, feet ~310 pixels from cell top. Every cell contains complete hands/feet with clear margins. Transparent empty area, no text, borders, arrows, shadows, ground, extra props, effects or background. Keep consistent character scale and grounded anatomy throughout. Not a contact sheet of different characters.
notes: Original RGBA bytes retained. Native AtlasTexture crops with transparent margins align feet at y=324 on a 352px canvas. No source pixel editing.
